content.comment_body: Is there a way to search for all occurrences in [product_name]? I want to identify every instance of a specific function block, including any connected inputs, throughout my entire diagram at once. I haven't found a way to do this in ladder diagrams. Is it possible in Function Block Diagrams (FBD)? I haven't tried working with FBDs yet. If this feature isn't available, it would be useful to add it in future releases. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, In FBD, you can see the connections, and a green symbol will appear at a signal. If you double-click the signal, the corresponding line will be shown. Hope this assists you. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing challenges when trying to locate all instances of a function block and its related inputs in a [product_name] project, particularly when using ladder diagrams. They are seeking a comprehensive 'find all' feature to improve traceability and navigation. Function Block Diagrams (FBD) seem to allow for easier signal tracing, though not a full solution for this request.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple 'find all instances' functionality within the software, allowing them to quickly identify every occurrence of a specific function block and its associated signals in their project diagrams.
